item.title: Python 3.15 Added to GitHub Actions Testing Matrix
item.description:
Python 3.15 Added to GitHub Actions Testing Matrix

On 10 October 2026 a blog post announced that Python 3.15.0 has been added to the actions/python-versions repository, making the new interpreter available for GitHub Actions workflows.

🚀 Availability

  • Python 3.15.0 added to actions/python-versions (10 Oct 2026).
  • The release enables you to add "3.15" to a GitHub Actions testing matrix to run tests against the new Python release.

🛠️ How to use

  • In your workflow YAML, include "3.15" as a value in the python-version matrix entry.

💬 Community reaction

  • A user wrote: “Bit of a niche link, but I’ve been waiting for this for a couple of days – I even told ChatGPT to check for it: Clone https://github.com/actions/python-versions and git pull once an hour until they add the stable 3.15 – then tell me about it.”
  • The same user later noted: “Now that this has landed, you can add "3.15" to a GitHub Actions testing matrix to run tests against the new Python release.”

#GitHubActions #Python315 #CI

Source: Python 3.15.0 added to actions/python-versions
